headline: Executive order on how federal agencies treat Native American sacred sites on federal land.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this 1996 order deals with Native American sacred sites. It is generally understood to direct federal agencies that manage federal land to allow Native American religious practitioners to reach and use these sites for ceremonies, and to avoid harming the sites where they reasonably can under the law. No summary was provided, so these details are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Native American tribes and religious practitioners
who_it_affects.how: The order addresses their access to and use of sacred sites located on federal land.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that manage public land
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to set expectations for how these agencies handle sacred sites when making land decisions.
